title: Power row of the binary Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $\ell$ be a positive natural number, and choose points $\alpha_0,\ldots,\alpha_{n-1}$ in the binary extension field of degree $\ell$. For $q\in\{0,\ldots,k-2\}$ and $i\in\{0,\ldots,\ell-1\}$, the entry in column $j$ of the row labelled by $(q,i)$ is the $i$th binary-coordinate of $\alpha_j^{q+1}$ with respect to the chosen basis of that field.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a natural number other than zero
A point in the binary extension field is specified for each column
